fact: NIMC's Alvan Ikoku says the identity database is hosted in Nigeria and managed by NIMC employees, not vendors.
Ikoku says NIMC maintains its core database internally with its own staff.
NIMC director-general said the commission's own Self-Service Modification Platform had processed close to two million record updates, cutting turnaround from weeks to 24-48 hours.
TechCabal reports that NIMC implements the ID4D project and is enrolling 1.5 to 1.8 million people a month and issuing NINs.
NIMC's Director-General says Nigeria is moving from NIMC 1.0, a vendor lock-in system expensive to maintain, to an open-source, locally driven NIMC 2.0.
Biometric Update reports NIMC renewed Idemia's contract for three years to upgrade the existing national biometric system, add ABIS licences and provide maintenance and support services.
NIMC, which the article calls the sole body mandated by the constitution for identity management, issues and runs the NIN system with about 124 million NINs by October 2025.
NIMC says the system integrator engaged for the MOSIP migration will work with its technical team to ensure transfer and capacity building.
